title: asplenium erectum var. usambarense
intro: Asplenium erectum var. usambarense, commonly known as the Usambarensis Ruffled Fern, is a type of fern plant belonging to the Aspleniaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of the Usambarensis Ruffled Fern include its ability to stimulate the immune system and act as an antiseptic, promoting wound healing and reducing the risk of infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
